events.text: Löw served as player-coach of FC Frauenfeld.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1994–95 , he served as player-coach of FC Frauenfeld .

events.text: Löw became an assistant coach to VfB Stuttgart head coach Rolf Fringer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1995–96 , he became an assistant coach to VfB Stuttgart head coach Rolf Fringer .

events.subject: self
events.quote: Löw was promoted caretaker manager on 14 August 1996 .

events.text: Löw's first match as head coach was a 4–0 win against Schalke 04.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His first match as head coach was a 4–0 win against Schalke 04 on 17 August 1996 .

events.text: Stuttgart finished the 1996–97 Bundesliga season in fourth place.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: They finished the 1996–97 Bundesliga season in fourth place .

events.text: The 1997–98 season started with a 3–0 against Karlsruher SC.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: The 1997–98 season started with a 3–0 against Karlsruher SC on 22 July 1997

events.text: Stuttgart lost in the final against Bayern Munich.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: They went on to lose in the final against Bayern Munich on 26 July 1997 .

events.text: Bayern Munich defeated Stuttgart 3–0 in the DFB-Pokal semi-final.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In the semi-final on 17 February 1998 , however , Bayern Munich defeated Stuttgart 3–0 .

events.text: Stuttgart lost 1–0 to Chelsea in the UEFA Cup Winners Cup final.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In the final on 13 May 1998 , Stuttgart lost 1–0 to Chelsea .

events.text: Löw left the club seven days later.
events.subject: self
events.quote: This proved to be his final match as he left the club seven days later .

events.subject: self
events.quote: Löw joined Turkish club Fenerbahçe on 1 July 1998 .

events.text: Fenerbahçe finished third in the Süper Lig during the 1998–99 season.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: During the 1998–99 season , Fenerbahçe finished third in the Süper Lig

events.text: Löw became manager of Karlsruher SC.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Löw became manager of Karlsruher SC on 25 October 1999 .

events.text: Löw's first match was a 1–1 draw against Hannover 96.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His first match was a 1–1 draw against Hannover 96 on 31 October 1999 .

events.text: Löw's final match was a 3–1 loss to Hannover.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His final match was a 3–1 loss to Hannover on 16 April 2000

events.text: Löw's only win came in a 2–1 win against Fortuna Köln.
events.subject: self
events.quote: his only win came in a 2–1 win against Fortuna Köln on 19 March 2000
